title: Velo Icy Berries Slim Nicotine Pouches - Original (10mg)
description: Velo Slim Icy Berries Nicotine Pouches bring together sweet Blueberries, tart Raspberries and dark Blackberry tones, finished with a fresh note of Spearmint. The result is a flavour that tastes fruity, layered and refreshing, offering a berry mix with a cool lift. Each can contains 20 slim pouches made from plant-based fibres, designed for a discreet and comfortable fit under the lip. Nicotine is released steadily without smoke, vapour or odour, making them a convenient option for daily use. Produced in Europe, Velo nicotine pouches are available in a wide variety of flavour profiles and strengths. Icy Berries is presented here in a Medium 10mg strength, providing a more potent release than lighter pouch options. Nicotine Ranges: Mellow - 4mg to 6mg this is best for new users. Original - 6mg to 11mg this is best for regular users. Intense - 8mg to 17mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
